name: Reach Machinery Co Ltd
summary: Reach Machinery Co., Ltd. is an enterprise focused on the design, production, and sale of essential components for automation equipment, power transmission, and braking systems, serving both the Chinese domestic and international markets. The company's diverse product portfolio encompasses precision transmission elements, electromagnetic brakes and clutches, harmonic reducers, couplings, expansion sleeves, and synchro wheels. These specialized parts are integral to a wide array of modern industrial applications, including robotics, automated assembly lines, elevators, wind power generation, CNC machinery, cranes, tower cranes, electric forklifts, automated three-dimensional parking garages, and high-altitude platform vehicles, as well as general automation and high-end manufacturing sectors. The firm was established in 2009 and is based in Chengdu, China.
